title: Copperline Cafe quarterly results
brief: Copperline Cafe, a 14-location franchise group, needs a quarterly results page for its franchise owners covering Q4 2025 through Q3 2026. All figures in dollars. Q4 2025: revenue 1842000, cost of goods 589000, labor 612000, rent and other 398000, operating profit 243000, margin 13.2 percent. Q1 2026: 1756000, 561000, 598000, 405000, 192000, 10.9 percent. Q2 2026: 1968000, 618000, 631000, 412000, 307000, 15.6 percent. Q3 2026: 2134000, 662000, 676000, 421000, 375000, 17.6 percent. Trailing four quarters: revenue 7700000, operating profit 1117000, margin 14.5 percent. Q3 revenue is up 8.4 percent on Q2 and 15.9 percent on Q4 2025. Sections: "Headline", "Quarterly results", "Margin trend" and "Notes". Notes: Q1 is the seasonal low; two new locations opened on 2026-05-18, which explains part of the Q2 and Q3 growth; the Q3 figures are unaudited.

edit.request: Q3 labor was corrected to 690000. Update Q3 operating profit to 361000 and margin to 16.9 percent, and the trailing four quarters to 1103000 and 14.3 percent.
